dataset: Per-instance outputs and stats of AHELM (HELM audio) suite v1.0.0, Stanford CRFM: every run listed in the GPT-4o Judge Critique column of the run-group pages audiocaps, air_bench_chat_knowledge, air_bench_chat_reasoning, first trial. Only run names, instance ids, output classes, counts and public model names are published.
note: requested = num_instances x num_respondents (1 everywhere included); dropped = requested - the count of HELM's gpt4_audio_critique stat, i.e. ratings HELM left out of the mean because the judge reply had no 'Rating: 1-5' (Stat.add skips None) or no reply came back. corrected = each dropped rating counted as 1, the lowest rating. A headline cell is rebuilt by the rule that reproduces it (pooled first, then mean of run means). Ranks: higher is better, 1 + number of models strictly higher. rating_text = model outputs that already contain a string HELM's judge regex would read (HELM issue #4344); exploratory.
